method.primary_source: data/cache/player_pool.json field `tsb` (teams selected by %) — 364 players. NOTE: data-lab.json did not surface this field; it is the only real ownership data in the cache.
method.secondary_source: WebSearch (Fantasy Football Scout, FantasyFootballHub, RotoWire, allaboutfpl) for captaincy share, which does NOT exist in any cache file.
method.validation: Cache tsb matches live reported ownership closely: Haaland 69.9 cache vs 70.1-75 reported; Ajer 4.5 vs 4.5; Gibbs-White 8.9 vs 9.3; Foden 4.6 vs 5.0; Egan 4.0m and Elanga 6.1m prices match. Cache ownership is TRUSTWORTHY.
method.eo_formula: eo_est = own% + (estimated captain share of ALL managers). Captain share discounted from poll figures (~25%) because polls skew to engaged/elite managers.
method.fixtures_inferred: MCI v COV (Etihad) — drives Haaland captaincy landslide and COV fdr 5. ARS v CHE (Emirates) — drives ARS fdr 4 / CHE fdr 5. EVE v MUN — B.Fernandes fdr 3 away. BRE v SUN — BRE fdr 2.

template_coverage.verdict: Adequate template coverage EXCEPT Haaland. Not owning the ~125% EO captain is the defining rank risk of GW3 and is NOT fixable with one free transfer (15.5m in, bank 0, Kerkez 5.5 out).

captain_shield.why: The GW3 template captain by a landslide: ~70% owned, 75% of the captaincy poll, MCI v COV at home, with mainstream outlets openly debating Triple Captain. We do not own him and cannot buy him this week. This is unavoidable damage — the correct response is to NOT COMPOUND IT. Every point Haaland scores is doubled for ~55% of the field. If he returns 12+, we lose ~25 net regardless of what we do; if we ALSO punt the captaincy to a low-EO player and B.Fernandes hauls, we lose twice.

This is the captain-shield pick. He is (a) the locked-protocol captain under CLAUDE.md (season cum_pts leader at 25, nailed premium 12.0m, not a GK), (b) 48% owned with ~8% captaincy, giving the highest floor of anything we own — 180/180 minutes, 105 bps (highest in the entire 364-player pool), 3 goals + 1 assist, penalties, set pieces, and last GW's mega-hauler, and (c) the only owned asset whose ceiling (20+) can partially claw back a Haaland haul. Given Haaland is unowned, captaining B.Fernandes is the field-neutral, backtest-compliant choice. Fading him for a 4.6m defender is precisely the error the backtest punished.

69.6% owned — the 2nd most-owned player in the game. xpts.json rates him 1.25 (fdr 5, away at Arsenal) which will tempt sim-lab to bench him. Benching a 70%-EO asset is a template fade with the same asymmetry as fading a template captain: if he returns, we lose to 70% of the field for a ~2 xPts gain. MUST START.

differentials.why: BEST DIFFERENTIAL. Joint-top scorer in the entire 364-player pool (20 pts) and the pool's best points-per-million (4.88). xpts 4.09, 2 clean sheets, 1 goal, 63 bps, 153/180 mins. At 4.1m it frees 1.4m from a Kerkez sale (Kerkez: 1 pt, 3.2% EO, dead weight).
Web-confirmed 4.5% ownership (exact cache match). xpts 4.35, fdr 2 with Sunderland visiting Brentford. Scores through defensive actions as well as clean sheets, so has a floor even without a CS.
Named in live differential coverage at £4.0m. 17 pts, xpts 3.82, ppm 4.25, 180/180 mins, 2 CS. Cheapest route to Hull's clean-sheet form; frees 1.5m for a future Haaland-funding move.
20 pts, 2 CS, xpts 4.14, 180/180. Genuine differential GK but the positional ceiling is capped ~9 and we already have Lammens. Low rank-chasing value.
xpts 4.15, fdr 2 v SUN (H). Same capped-ceiling caveat as Tzolakis.
HIGHEST-CEILING sub-8% pick: 17 pts, 1G+1A, fdr 2, starting Liverpool attacker. NOT affordable this week (7.0m vs 5.5m out, bank 0). Flag to market-desk as a 2-week target.
Named in live differential coverage. 17 pts, 2 goals, and price is RISING (net_rate +59.98, already +0.1). Not affordable now — cost will keep climbing. Second 2-week target.
DEEPEST PUNT: 1.6% owned, 16 pts, 1G+1A, 66 bps, 177/180 mins, fdr 2. Exactly affordable for Kerkez. High variance — rank-chasing only, not a floor pick.
14 pts, 60 bps, 180/180, 0.66 xA — attacking full-back profile. Solid but strictly worse xpts (3.27) than Ajayi/Ajer.

borderline_not_a_differential.why: At 8.9% EO he is above the <8% differential threshold, so he buys little rank leverage. As Gemini's transfer_in he is defensible (top xPts 4.77, fdr 2, 15 pts, 4.6m fits the Kerkez sale). As Gemini's CAPTAIN he is indefensible — see rank_risks[1].

rank_risks.risk: Haaland non-ownership. ~70% own + ~55% captaincy = ~125% effective ownership, at home to Coventry, with the community debating Triple Captain on him.
rank_risks.exposure: A 12+ pt Haaland return costs roughly 25 net points versus the field. There is no defensive play available.
rank_risks.action: ACCEPT AND DO NOT COMPOUND. Cannot be bought (15.5m in vs 5.5m Kerkez out, bank 0.0, squad value 100.2). Flag to market-desk/the-gaffer as the primary multi-week funding objective; flag to the-director as the expected cause if GW3 rank falls.

rank_risks.risk: Gemini recommends captaining Kayode (8.9% EO, 4.6m defender) over B.Fernandes (56% EO, season cum_pts leader).
rank_risks.exposure: This is a double fade — it fades the actual template captain (Haaland, already unowned) AND the shield captain (B.Fernandes). A 4.6m defender's realistic ceiling is ~13 (goal + CS + bonus); a premium midfielder's is 20+. Captaining a defender caps our upside in the exact week we most need variance to recover the Haaland gap.
rank_risks.action: HARD BLOCK. Recommend sim-lab and the-gaffer reject the Kayode captaincy and keep B.Fernandes (C). This is the specific 'fading template captains lost points' failure mode the backtest identified, and it also violates the LOCKED CLAUDE.md rule (captain = season cum_pts leader, nailed premium, not GK). Keep Kayode as the transfer_in — that part is sound.

rank_risks.risk: xpts.json model bias. It rates Haaland at 1.80 and Thiago at 0.24 (despite Thiago's 1.8 xG) while rating 4.0-4.6m defenders at 3.7-4.8.
rank_risks.exposure: The model is clean-sheet/defence-weighted and systematically underrates forwards this GW. This bias is the direct cause of Gemini's Kayode captaincy (captain_xpts 9.54 vs B.Fernandes 5.64).
rank_risks.action: Warn sim-lab: DO NOT rank captaincy on raw captain_xpts this week. Use it for transfer targets only.

rank_risks.risk: ARS v CHE fixture collision. We own Gabriel + Calafiori (ARS, fdr 4) AND João Pedro + Rogers (CHE, fdr 5) — 4 of 11 starters in a single hard match at the Emirates.
rank_risks.exposure: Guaranteed partial failure: the two clean-sheet assets and the two attacking assets cannot both pay off. Combined xpts for the four is only 7.46.
rank_risks.action: Do not bench João Pedro (70% EO — see captain_shield). Rogers (25.6% EO, xpts 0.91) is the defensible bench candidate if a swap is needed.

rank_risks.risk: Triple-Coventry bench: Rushworth (GK), Awoniyi (FWD), van Ewijk (DEF) all face Man City away in the fixture ~70% of the field is captaining.
rank_risks.exposure: Bench is effectively dead (combined xpts 1.10, all fdr 5). Bench Boost was already used at GW2 so there is no direct chip exposure, but there is zero usable cover if a starter is a late scratch.
rank_risks.action: Note for medical-bay: confirm all 11 starters before deadline — the safety net is worthless this week. van Ewijk at 12.4% EO is a surprisingly widely-held 4.0m filler.

rank_risks.risk: Mbeumo (31.5% EO) is the most-sold player in FPL since the GW2 deadline.
rank_risks.exposure: His EO is falling, so holding converts him from a template asset into an unintentional differential. Mildly rank-positive if he returns, mildly negative if he blanks.
rank_risks.action: Monitor only. Not a GW3 transfer priority — Kerkez (1 pt, 3.2% EO) is the clear sale.

rank_risks.risk: Thiago (BRE, 8.0m, 15.0% EO) — 2 pts, 1.8 xG with 0 goals, bps -1, xpts 0.24.
rank_risks.exposure: Low EO so little rank risk in owning him, but he is an 8.0m points sink and the best source of funds for a future Haaland move (8.0m + Kerkez 5.5m = 13.5m).
rank_risks.action: Flag to market-desk as the GW4-5 funding lever, not a GW3 move.

rank_risks.risk: Triple Captain chip. Community is actively debating TC on Haaland for MCI v COV.
rank_risks.exposure: None for us — TC requires a captain worth tripling and we do not own Haaland. CLAUDE.md also restricts TC to a confirmed DGW, and GW3 is a single gameweek.
rank_risks.action: TC stays holstered. Confirms field captain-concentration is even higher than the raw poll implies.

summary_for_gaffer.shield_captain: B.Fernandes — keep (C). Protocol-compliant (cum_pts leader) AND EO-defensible.
summary_for_gaffer.approve: Gemini's Kerkez -> Kayode transfer (or upgrade to Ajayi for a deeper differential + 1.4m banked).
